data.long_meaning: From the Greek 'bodon', meaning 'soldier' or 'armed'. In Christian tradition, this name represents a fighter for righteousness and goodness. The name Bondon carries the meaning “Soldier of the good” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bondon usually hope their child will grow to embody soldier of the good and live with faith, good character and purpose.
